strain: Sprague-Dawley rats; C57BL/6J and 129S6/SvEv mice; 5-HT2AR KO mice on 129S6/SvEv background

age.evidence: Adult male rats and mice (3 -4 months old) were used for all experiments.

sex.evidence: Adult male rats and mice (3 -4 months old) were used for all experiments.

dosing.doses_raw: Sprague-Dawley rats were tested with three different doses of DOI (0.2 mg/kg, 1 mg/kg and 2 mg/kg) compared to saline controls. C57BL/6J and 129S6/SvEv (Wild type as well as 5-HT2AR KO) mice were tested with saline or 1 mg/kg DOI.
dosing.evidence: Animals were administered either vehicle (0.9 % saline) or DOI (Sigma-Aldrich, Cat. No. 42203 -78-1) via intraperitoneal ( i.p. ) injections, prior to behavioral testing on the Elevated Plus Maze (EPM).

group_housing.evidence: not reported; paper states only that animals 'were bred and maintained in the animal house facility'

day_night_flipped.evidence: All animals were bred and maintained in the animal house facility ... on a 12h light-dark cycle from 7 am to 7 pm

assays.assay_description: Sprague-Dawley rats placed in the centre of the EPM (arms 45 x 10 cm, elevated 60 cm, closed-arm walls 60 cm) for 5 min, 20 min after i.p. vehicle or DOI (0.2, 1, 2 mg/kg). Ethovision XT tracking of total distance, velocity, percent mobility, percent time in open/closed arms, anxiety index, and fold change in distance; locomotion-anxiety correlations.

application_type.evidence: via intraperitoneal ( i.p. ) injections, prior to behavioral testing on the Elevated Plus Maze (EPM)

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were placed in the center either facing the open arms or the closed arms (chosen at random) of the EPM; no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the EPM during the 5-min test; home cage 'ad libitum access to food and water'.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the EPM during the 5-min test; home cage 'ad libitum access to food and water'.

time_to_assay.evidence: Animals were placed in the maze for five minutes, 20 min after intraperitoneally injecting the drug.

sample_size.evidence: not explicitly reported (only degrees of freedom given in statistics)

outcomes.summary: 0.2 mg/kg DOI had no effect on locomotion or anxiety measures. 1 and 2 mg/kg DOI reduced total distance, velocity and percent mobility and reduced anxiety-like behaviour (more open-arm time, less closed-arm time, lower anxiety index), with a significant dose effect on fold-change locomotion and anxiety index; locomotion and anxiety index correlated at 1 and 2 mg/kg.
outcomes.statistics: 1 mg/kg: distance p=0.0032, F(12)=48.28; velocity p=0.0031, F(12)=48.23; mobility p=0.0003, F(12)=13.76; open arm p<0.0001, F(12)=4.072; closed arm p<0.0001, F(12)=1.048; anxiety index p<0.0001, F(12)=1.414. 2 mg/kg: distance p=0.0001, F(17)=1.191; velocity p<0.0001, F(17)=1.563; mobility p<0.0001, F(17)=2.359; open arm p=0.0004, F(17)=1.246; closed arm p=0.0164 (Mann-Whitney U); anxiety index p=0.002 (Mann-Whitney U). Dose effect on locomotion fold change: p<0.0001, F(2,20)=24.55; Bonferroni 0.2 vs 1 p=0.0002, 0.2 vs 2 p<0.0001. Dose effect on anxiety index p=0.0005 (Kruskal-Wallis); Dunn 0.2 vs 1 p=0.0047, 0.2 vs 2 p<0.0016. Correlation: 0.2 mg/kg R2=0.082 (ns); 1 mg/kg p=0.0112, R2=0.75; 2 mg/kg p<0.0001, R2=0.90.
outcomes.evidence: Animals treated with a higher dose of 1 mg/kg DOI showed a decline in exploratory measures on the EPM ... we find that there is a significant effect of DOI dose on locomotion ( p < 0.0001, F(2, 20) = 24.55)

assays.assay_description: C57BL/6J, 129S6/SvEv WT and 5-HT2AR KO (129S6/SvEv background) mice placed in the EPM (arms 30 x 5 cm, elevated 15 cm, closed-arm walls 15 cm) for 5 min, 20 min after i.p. vehicle or 1 mg/kg DOI. Ethovision XT tracking of total distance, speed, percent mobility, percent open/closed arm time, anxiety index, fold change in distance; strain and genotype comparisons and correlations.

application_type.evidence: via intraperitoneal ( i.p. ) injections, prior to behavioral testing on the Elevated Plus Maze (EPM)

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were placed in the center either facing the open arms or the closed arms (chosen at random) of the EPM; no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the EPM during the 5-min test; home cage 'ad libitum access to food and water'.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the EPM during the 5-min test; home cage 'ad libitum access to food and water'.

time_to_assay.evidence: Animals were placed in the maze for five minutes, 20 min after intraperitoneally injecting the drug.

sample_size.evidence: not explicitly reported (only degrees of freedom given in statistics)

outcomes.summary: 1 mg/kg DOI increased total distance and speed (not mobility) in C57BL/6J mice but decreased distance, speed and mobility in 129S6/SvEv mice; both strains showed reduced anxiety-like behaviour (higher open-arm time, lower anxiety index). DOI had no locomotor or anxiety effects in 5-HT2AR KO mice, and fold-change locomotion differed between WT and KO.
outcomes.statistics: C57BL/6J: distance p=0.045, F(15)=1.104; speed p=0.0449, F(15)=1.103; open arm p=0.019, F(15)=1.605; anxiety index p=0.034, F(15)=3.972; correlation p=0.006, R2=0.63. 129S6/SvEv: distance p=0.0025, F(12)=1.312; speed p=0.0025, F(12)=1.312; mobility p=0.0016, F(12)=1.06; open arm p=0.0012, F(12)=5.181; closed arm p=0.025 (Mann-Whitney U); anxiety index p=0.0181 (Mann-Whitney U); correlation R2=0.34 (ns). Vehicle baseline 129 vs C57 p=0.0021, F(12)=4.99. Cross-model fold change p<0.0001, F(2,21)=26.73; anxiety index p=0.0006 (Kruskal-Wallis), C57 vs 129 p=0.0004. WT vs KO fold change p=0.0464, F(13)=2.592; anxiety index p=0.09 (Mann-Whitney U).
outcomes.evidence: While Sprague-Dawley rats and 129S6/SvEv mice exhibit reduced movement in response to 1 mg/kg DOI, C57BL/6J mice show increased movement at the same dose.

judge_notes: Split EPM into rat and mouse assays per rubric rule that the same test in different species constitutes separate assays (following qwen; deepseek4 and gemma4 merged them). C57BL/6J, 129S6/SvEv WT and 5-HT2AR KO mice collapsed into a single mouse EPM assay (strain/genotype differences are not separate assays).
B1 set to score 2 (4-6 measures); gemma4's score of 3 was inconsistent with its own '4-6' value.
E3/E4 marked as definitionally absent for the EPM with high confidence; D-items raised to high confidence since the 5-min single post-injection session is explicitly stated.
Food/water restriction set to 'during' (no food/water in EPM apparatus) per rubric default; home-cage feeding was ad libitum.
Sample sizes not explicitly stated (only dfs), left null.
Age set to 'adult' (paper says 'Adult ... 3-4 months old'), 90-120 days.
